ng-add.description: Set up Feature-Sliced Design in an Angular workspace: layers, aliases, fsd.config.json, ApiClient, TanStack Query provider and route markers.

feature.description: Generate an FSD feature slice (TanStack Angular Query, NgRx Signal Store; `auth` adds typed reactive forms validated with zod).

widget.description: Generate an FSD widget slice (navbar, sidebar, footer and bottom-bar are presets).

page.description: Generate an FSD page slice and register it as a lazy route in src/app/app.routes.ts.
